entries.cause: Issue #1037: the unread lastLossMonth field is removed from TradeProtectionState; this replay records a merchant loss in month 3, so the month 3, 4 and 5 snapshot hashes change while event hashes stay equal.
entries.migrationAssessment: The tradeProtection state is absent from StorableCampaignStateSchema in packages/persistence, so no save file stores lastLossMonth. Only the in-memory snapshot shape changes; the loss, pool and unrest outcomes are computed from merchantPoolBp as before.
